title: The Mill CPU Architecture – The Compiler (10 of 13)
summary: A long Mill Computing lecture on the Mill CPU's compiler toolchain, covering the specializer that targets family members, scheduling and latency passes, and the belt. It explains how the compiler handles a wide-issue, exposed-pipeline design.
why: Cited as the authoritative source on how Mill's VLIW-style compiler specializes code and differs from Itanium.
